rationale: Enterprise legal copilot. RAG over firm + case-law corpora; citations are core to product trust. SOC2 II, ISO 27001, attorney-client confidentiality posture (no training on client data). Narrow legal domain reduces hallucination range, but legal use raises stakes severely; bias and counterfactual stability are particularly load-bearing in disposition recommendations. Less external red-teaming visibility than frontier consumer surfaces.
